title: Microsoft 365 Tenant-to-Tenant Migration - Simply Explained
description:
Most companies think a Microsoft 365 migration is just copying files from one account to another, and that assumption is exactly what sinks the project. When a merger closes or a division gets sold, two separate Microsoft accounts have to become one, and nothing carries over on its own.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What a tenant really is
  • Why companies leave one tenant for another
  • What actually moves
  • The Teams problem
  • The domain move
  • Running both tenants at once
  • Cutover weekend
  • What usually goes wrong
  • The recap

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
